name: Three Men's Morris
region: Europe (Roman times and the Middle Ages)
setup: The board is empty. Each player has three pieces in hand.
moves: Players take turns placing one piece on any empty point until all six pieces are on the board.
Then each turn one piece moves along a line to an adjacent empty point.
win: The first player to get their three pieces in a row along a line wins.

notes.en: Sources differ on the moving phase: some let a piece go to any empty point, most describe a step to an adjacent point along a line. This file uses the step. Some sources also forbid the first piece in the centre; this file does not. A draw by the same position three times is a convention of the app.
notes.ro: Sursele diferă la faza de mutare: unele lasă piesa să meargă pe orice punct liber, cele mai multe descriu un pas pe un punct vecin, de-a lungul unei linii. Fișierul folosește pasul. Unele surse interzic și prima piesă în centru; fișierul nu o face. Remiza prin aceeași poziție de trei ori este o convenție a aplicației.
